name: uncounterable_gaeas_herald_itself_is_countered
note: Gaea's Herald's 'Creature spells can't be countered.' is a static ability of the permanent: it works from the battlefield (CR 113.6), not while the Herald is itself a spell (only 'this spell can't be countered' works on the stack, CR 113.6g). P1's Cancel counters the Herald being cast. Found by the fresh-eyes review of this branch: the first consult read every 'can't be countered' static off the spell's own record, so the Herald entered.
